sentences.text:
Applicant :- Ranjana
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. And 7 Others

Counsel for Applicant :- Ankit Agarval Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Manoj Bajaj,J.
Applicant-Ranjana has filed this application under Section 447 B.N.S.S., 2023 for transfer of Criminal Case No. 551 of 2019; titled State vs. Kuldeep Singh and others, arising out of Case Crime No. 221 of 2018, under Sections 498A, 323, 504 and 506 IPC and Section 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act, Police Station Arniya, District Bulandshahr pending before Civil Judge (Junior Division/Judicial Magistrate), Khurja Bulandshahr to the court of competent jurisdiction at District Aligarh.

entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Despite service, no one has appeared on behalf of the opposite party nos. 2 to 8.

During the course of hearing, it is not disputed by the learned counsel for the applicant that the two cases which are pending at Aligarh were instituted by the applicant subsequent to the criminal prosecution of the accused initiated in February, 2018 for the alleged commission of offence punishable under Section 498A IPC etc, and the case was lodged by the complainant-applicant herself at Bulandshahr.
The said case is pending for last seven years and considering the distance of 50 kms. between the two towns, no ground is made out for transfer of the case.
